blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models such as CLIP achieve strong zero-shot classification, yet under distribution shift, visual embeddings drift from fixed text embeddings. Training-free calibration avoids the per-sample optimization of prompt learning, but prior feature calibration gives each image the full bias of one hard cluster. We propose D omain R ecentering with C onfidence Calibration (DRC), a training-free method adapting CLIP from a set of unlabeled target images. DRC fits a Gaussian mixture once and subtracts from each embedding a posterior-weighted average of component means. It then removes residual class preference with a log-prior correction, estimating the prior from confidence-weighted predictions. Among compared methods, DRC achieves the highest average accuracy on cross-domain datasets, exceeding zero-shot CLIP by 4.13 and 5.07 points with ViT-B/16 and ResNet-50, with gains over CLIP also holding under ImageNet distribution shifts.
blocks.zh: CLIP等视觉语言模型实现了强烈的零镜头分类,然而在分布移位中,视觉嵌入从固定文本嵌入中漂移. 无训练校准避免了快速学习的每样优化,但之前的特征校准使每个图像完全偏向一个硬集群. 我们提议使用 C 事件校准(DRC) 进行 D omain R 中心,这是一种从一组没有标签的目标图像中修改 CLIP 的无训练方法。 DRC适合高斯混合物一次,从每个嵌入的后加权平均值中减去组件的平均值。 然后,它通过对数前修正来消除剩余类偏好,从置信加权预测中估算出先前的偏好. 在比较方法中,刚果民主共和国的跨域数据集平均准确度最高,与VIT-B/16和ResNet-50相比,CLIP的零射分超过4.13和5.07分,CLIP的增益也保持在ImageNet分布转移下。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models have emerged as powerful foundation models for visual recognition. CLIP [ 7 ] learns a multi-modal embedding space for images and text from natural language supervision at scale, enabling zero-shot classification by aligning an image’s embedding with the text embeddings of class descriptions. However, when target images differ from the pretraining distribution, their visual embeddings can become misaligned with the fixed text embeddings, degrading classification accuracy.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型作为视觉识别的强大基础模型出现. CLIP [7] 从自然语言监督中大规模学习图像和文本的多模式嵌入空间,通过将图像嵌入与类描述的文本嵌入对齐,实现零镜头分类. 然而,当目标图像不同于预训分布时,其视觉嵌入可能与固定文本嵌入错位,降低分类精度.

blocks.en: Recent works have adapted CLIP under distribution shift along two broad directions. One line performs prompt learning with few-shot labeled data [ 12 , 11 ] or test-time entropy minimization [ 9 , 2 ] , requiring labels or per-image backpropagation. Another line calibrates features without training, using unlabeled target data. UMFC [ 5 ] corrects visual encoder bias by subtracting from each feature the mean of its hard-assigned cluster. However, a feature near a cluster boundary then receives one cluster’s full mean, so a small change in the feature can flip its correction. Correcting the image features alone also leaves the text classifier unchanged, so any preference it holds for certain classes persists.
blocks.zh: 近期的作品在分配方面沿两个大方向调整了CLIP。 一行用几发标注的数据进行即时学习[12,11]或试验时的entropy最小化[9,2],要求标签或每幅图像反射. 另一行校准功能不经过训练,使用无标签的目标数据. UMFC [5] 修正视觉编码器偏差,从每个特性中减去其硬派集群的平均值. 然而,一个靠近集群边界的特征随后得到一个集群的完全平均值,因此该特征的微小变化可以翻转它的校正. 仅更正图像特征也使文本分类器保持不变,因此它对某些类的任何偏好都持续存在.

blocks.en: We propose Domain Recentering with Confidence Calibration (DRC), which models the structure of unlabeled CLIP visual features using a Gaussian mixture model. Rather than assigning each image to a single cluster, DRC uses mixture-component posterior probabilities to construct a soft, image-specific bias vector as a weighted combination of component means, so the correction changes continuously as the feature moves between components. This vector is subtracted from the image feature to suppress domain-related variation while preserving class-discriminative content. DRC further corrects residual class preferences through confidence-weighted prior calibration, without any backpropagation or parameter updates. Among the compared methods, DRC achieves the highest average accuracy on ten cross-domain datasets with both ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16, and it also improves the average accuracy of zero-shot CLIP over four ImageNet distribution shifts.
blocks.zh: 我们提议使用高斯混合模型模拟无标签CLIP视觉特征的结构。 DRC没有将每个图像分配给一个单一的集群,而是使用混合物组件后概率来构建一个软的,图像特定偏差矢量作为组件的加权组合手段,因此修正随着特性在组件之间移动而持续变化. 此矢量从图像特性中减去,以抑制与域相关的变异,同时保留类区分内容. DRC进一步通过置信加权前校准来纠正剩余类偏好,而没有任何反射或参数更新. 在比较方法中,DRC在ResNet-50和Vit-B/16的10个跨域数据集上实现了最高平均精度,并且还比4个ImageNet分布班次提高了零射CLIP的平均精度.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prompt learning adapts CLIP [ 7 ] to downstream data by tuning its textual prompts. CoOp [ 12 ] and CoCoOp [ 11 ] learn these prompts from labeled few-shot data. Test-time adaptation instead uses unlabeled test samples to improve robustness under distribution shifts. TPT [ 9 ] optimizes prompts for each test sample, and DiffTPT [ 2 ] extends TPT with diffusion-based augmentation. Both repeat backpropagation for every test sample, which makes inference costly and motivates training-free adaptation that leaves the pretrained model unchanged.
blocks.zh: 即时学习通过调整其文字提示使CLIP[7]适应下游数据. CoOp [12]和CoCoOp [11] 从标注的几发数据中学习这些提示. 试验时间的适应则使用无标签的试验样本,以提高分配转移中的稳健性。 TPT [9] 优化每个测试样本的提示,DiffTPT [2] 延长TPT,以扩散为基础的增强. 两者都重复每个测试样本的反向传播,这使得推论成本高昂,并激励无训练适应,使预训模型保持不变.

blocks.en: Training-free methods instead correct the systematic biases that zero-shot vision-language models exhibit in representations and predictions [ 5 , 6 ] . UMFC [ 5 ] subtracts each hard-assigned cluster’s mean, giving all images within a cluster the same correction. Label-free logit adjustment [ 13 ] offsets label bias in predictions. Our method instead assigns each image its own bias by weighting Gaussian mixture component means with the image’s soft assignment. It then estimates the class prior from the recentered predictions with confidence weighting, so that the prior targets the bias left after feature correction.
blocks.zh: 无训练方法相反地纠正了零射视觉语言模型在表示和预测中表现出的系统性偏差[5,6]. UMFC [5] 减去了每个硬派集群的平均值,使集群内的所有图像都得到同样的修正. 无标签日志调整 [13] 抵消了预测中的标签偏差. 我们的方法通过对高斯混合成分进行加权来分配每个图像本身的偏差, 然后,它用置信度加权来估计最近预测之前的类别,这样,先前的目标就是特征修正后留下的偏差。

blocks.en: Recentering acts only on the image features and leaves the classifier weights 𝐭 c \mathbf{t}_{c} unchanged, so the class preference of the zero-shot classifier [ 13 , 6 ] can persist in the recentered predictions. DRC estimates this preference from predictions on 𝒟 u \mathcal{D}_{u} and removes it with a log-prior adjustment, weighting each prediction by its confidence.

4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate DRC on the cross-domain benchmark and the out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmark. For cross-domain evaluation, we use the same ten datasets as TPT [ 9 ] , which are Aircraft, Caltech101, Cars, DTD, EuroSAT, Flower102, Food101, Pets, SUN397, and UCF101. The OOD benchmark measures robustness to distribution shifts with four variants of ImageNet [ 1 ] , ImageNet-A [ 4 ] , ImageNet-V2 [ 8 ] , ImageNet-R [ 3 ] and ImageNet-Sketch [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们按跨域基准和分配外基准评价刚果民主共和国。 对于跨域评价,我们使用与TPT[9]相同的10个数据集,即飞机,Caltech101,汽车,DTD,EuroSAT,Flower102,Food101,Pets,SUN397和UCF101. OOD基准衡量分布变化的稳健性,有ImageNet[1],ImageNet-A[4],ImageNet-V2[8],ImageNet-R[3]和ImageNet-Sketch[10]四个变体.

blocks.en: Table 1: Results on the Cross-Domain Benchmark with CLIP-ResNet-50 and CLIP-ViT-B/16. CoOp and CoCoOp serve as supervised transfer baselines trained on ImageNet with 16 labeled samples per class. CLIP, CoOp, CoCoOp, and TPT results are taken from the original TPT paper [ 9 ] , and DiffTPT results are taken from the original DiffTPT paper [ 2 ] .

blocks.en: Implementation details. Text embeddings obtained from dataset-specific prompt templates are averaged into a single vector for each class, and image features are extracted from each image and its horizontal flip. DRC uses PCA and a diagonal-covariance GMM ( n init = 5 n_{\mathrm{init}}=5 , seed 42). The adaptation set 𝒟 u \mathcal{D}_{u} is the validation split of each cross-domain dataset and the unlabeled evaluation images for ImageNet and its variants. K K and β \beta are selected by accuracy on the validation split of each cross-domain dataset, and on the ImageNet validation set for the OOD benchmark, with the ImageNet values reused for all four variants.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 从数据集特定即时模板中获取的文本嵌入物平均为每个类的单个矢量,从每个图像及其水平翻转中提取图像特征. DRC使用五氯苯甲醚和一个对角-共变GM(n init = 5 n_{\mathrm{init}}=5,种子42). 适应集 Du \ mathcal{D}_{u} 是每个跨域数据集的验证分割和ImageNet及其变体的无标签评价图像. K K和β \beta根据每个跨域数据集的验证分拆的准确性进行选择,根据OOD基准的ImageNet验证集进行选择,所有四个变体的ImageNet值都重复使用.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Art
blocks.zh: 4.2 与艺术国家的比较

blocks.en: Cross-Domain Benchmark. Table 1 evaluates DRC across ten datasets with disjoint class spaces. DRC achieves the highest average accuracy with both CLIP-ViT-B/16 and CLIP-ResNet-50, reaching 68.72% and 61.70%, respectively. These results improve over zero-shot CLIP by 4.13 and 5.07 points, and DRC ranks first on 7 and 6 of the 10 datasets, respectively. On EuroSAT, DRC improves over the best competing method by 10.75 and 3.80 points, and on UCF101, the gains are 3.52 and 2.33 points, respectively.
blocks.zh: 跨领域基准。 表1对刚果民主共和国的10个数据组进行分级评价。 DRC达到最高平均精度,CLIP-ViT-B/16和CLIP-ResNet-50均分别达到68.72%和61.70%. 这些结果比零发CLIP提高了4.13分和5.07分,刚果民主共和国在10个数据集中分别排在7位和6位第一. 在EuroSAT上,刚果民主共和国比最佳竞争方法提高了10.75分和3.80分,在UCF101上,收益分别为3.52分和2.33分。

blocks.en: OOD Benchmark. Table 2 further evaluates DRC on the OOD benchmark. With CLIP-ViT-B/16, DRC achieves the highest Average and OOD Average of 62.79% and 60.94%. With CLIP-ResNet-50, DRC achieves 48.53% and 45.14%, improving over zero-shot CLIP by 2.10 and 2.05 points, respectively. The gains are particularly pronounced under strong appearance shifts. DRC achieves the highest accuracy on ImageNet-R/S for both backbones (61.39%/39.94% for CLIP-ResNet-50, 78.14%/52.09% for CLIP-ViT-B/16).
blocks.zh: OD基准。 表2进一步评估了刚果民主共和国的OD基准。 刚果民主共和国通过CLIP-ViT-B/16,实现了最高的平均水平和OD平均值,分别为62.79%和60.94%。 使用CLIP-ResNet-50,刚果民主共和国的CLIP分别达到48.53%和45.14%,比零发CLIP提高了2.10和2.05分。 在强烈的外观变化下,这些成果尤其显著。 DRC在ImageNet-R/S上对两个主干线的准确度最高(CLIP-ResNet-50为61.39%/39.94%,CLIP-ViT-B/16为78.14%/52.09%)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: We perform ablation studies on the cross-domain benchmark with CLIP-ViT-B/16 to examine the effectiveness of domain recentering and confidence-weighted prior calibration.
blocks.zh: 我们用CLIP-ViT-B/16对跨域基准进行减速研究,以审查域更新和信心加权前校准的有效性。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , both components improve over the CLIP baseline. Soft recentering outperforms hard recentering both without and with prior calibration. Confidence-weighted prior calibration provides the largest gain, increasing the average accuracy to 68.35%. Combining both components yields the best result, with DRC achieving an average accuracy of 68.72%.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,这两个组成部分都比《油污损害控制方案》的基线有所改善。 柔软的近代性能比硬的近代性要强,既没有前期的校准,也没有前期的校准. 信心加权前校准提供了最大的收益,将平均精度提高到68.35%. 将这两个部分合并,产生最佳结果,刚果民主共和国的平均准确度为68.72%。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we proposed DRC, a training-free method that improves the robustness of CLIP under distribution shift without any backpropagation or parameter updates. DRC fits a Gaussian mixture to unlabeled target features and subtracts from each feature a soft, image-specific bias, so that the correction varies continuously across mixture components. It then corrects class preferences remaining in the recentered predictions with a confidence-weighted class prior. DRC achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared methods on the cross-domain benchmark and improves the OOD Average of zero-shot CLIP with both backbones.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议了刚果民主共和国,这是一种免费培训的方法,它提高了分销转移下的CLIP的稳健性,没有任何反向传播或参数更新。 DRC将高斯混合物与未贴标签的目标特征相匹配,并从每个特征中减去一个柔软的,图像特有的偏差,这样,各种混合物成分的校正就会持续变化. 然后用置信加权等级来纠正最近预测中剩余的类偏好. DRC在跨域基准的比较方法中实现了最高的平均准确性,并用两种主干提高了OOD平均值为零射线CLIP.
